# Online Lab Notebook

::: {.tagline}
Allyson DeMerlis, PhD · Coral Reef Molecular Ecologist
:::

This notebook documents my day-to-day work learning and running analyses for coral transcriptomics, bioinformatics, and statistics, mostly in R and bash. It is by no means a tutorial, as most of the stuff probably didn't work! But it's a useful record of what I tried, so it's easier to pick a project back up after a few days (or weeks) away.
